title: AI-assisted construction takeoff for quantity surveyors
problem: Quantity surveyors and estimators still spend substantial time measuring drawings/PDFs and moving quantities into spreadsheets or estimating systems.
target_user: Small construction estimators, quantity surveyors and subcontractors with repetitive takeoff workflows
solution_wedge: Undetermined. A generic AI takeoff tool is already crowded; a narrower trade-specific or workflow-specific wedge would be required.
evidence_summary: Public discussions describe takeoff as repetitive manual work often performed in Bluebeam/PDF tools and Excel, but current evidence is not yet strong enough to establish a differentiated opportunity.
reason: Pain appears real, but competition is significant and no sufficiently sharp wedge has been identified yet.
next_step: Only promote if repeated signals reveal a specific trade, document type, handoff, or failure mode underserved by current takeoff tools.
